audit.why: Mel is 41.74% over 242 Emerald+ games and the full layer already rates it HARD 8/10 with Kled carry 8.5/10. That matches the data.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Level 6 to Mel at 7/10, but both the content why for that stage and the Lvl 6 spike describe Kled ult taking the lane over.
audit.why: Kled level 6 is an off-screen engage on a 140s cooldown that also shields him on arrival. Nothing about Golden Eclipse coming online beats that in a 1v1 - Mel has no dash and the content layer says so in the very next field. The chart disagreed with its own prose and with a 41.74% win rate.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Kled at 4/10. Whole chart re-proposed as one group: Mel, Skill, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled. whys[4] and whys[6] rewritten to match, since whys[6] still claimed the late game was even while the chart and the late block both give it to Kled.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction was never stated. Bear Trap on a Rope is a projectile and Rebuttal reflects it, but the full layer only said the reflect was for "his real spell" and never named which. Solar Snare versus Jousting was also absent.
audit.why: Riot text makes Bear Trap a projectile and Jousting a dash. Reflecting the hook removes his entire engage for its 11s cooldown, and a root denies a dash cast, so Solar Snare is what stops Jousting. Those two facts are the lane. Separately, Chaaaaaaaarge!!! grants a shield on arrival, so burst dumped into the engage is wasted - the _missing file flags exactly this and nothing in either layer mentioned it.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, dosFull[0] and dosFull[2] now name the hook as the reflect target with its 11s cooldown, name Jousting as a dash that passes through the barrier, and give the root as the answer to it. dontsFull[2].d now covers the ult shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad said Rebuttal is "gone for twenty seconds".
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s. It is never as short as twenty seconds, so the advice understated how committal the reflect is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability names were misspelled throughout the content layer: "Beartrap on a Rope" and "Chaaaaaaaarrrrge!!!".
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon gives "Bear Trap on a Rope" (three words) and "Chaaaaaaaarge!!!" - the content layer added extra r characters to the ult. A player searching either string finds nothing.
audit.corrected: Both names corrected everywhere they appear, with no other wording changed so the length band is untouched.

edits.before: Level 1 is the one clean window I get — Kled starts mounted but his Skaarl mount has its own HP pool, and my 550-range Q plus empowered autos chip it for free before his Beartrap on a Rope (Q) can hook me in. The instant he hits 2 and his hook is online, that flips: if his Q lands he reels himself onto me, and I have zero dashes to peel off. Hold Rebuttal (W) specifically for his Q grab — eating that projectile and firing it back is my only hard answer to his engage. Never walk up to throw Radiant Volley (Q) when his hook is up.

edits.before: This is Kled's lane to take. A dismounted Kled who Skaarl-charges sticks to me right through Solar Snare's (E) root and remounts mid-fight, healing the chunk I just dealt — my short trade windows don't out-DPS his remount sustain. At 6 his Chaaaaaaaarrrrge!!! (R) is a free gap-close from off-screen, so I can be poking a safe wave and still get run down. I keep Rebuttal for the Q hook, save Solar Snare to root him AFTER he commits (not as a poke tool), and call for jungle help rather than trying to 1v1 a remounting Kled.

edits.before: Past two items this stays Kled's window — he's a hard scaler, and his bruiser build plus dismount burst and remount sustain out-statcheck my poke even though my Overwhelm passive scales infinitely. My one path is range discipline in teamfights: detonate Golden Eclipse (R) on stacked targets from max distance and never let him flank me with his charge.
